integrity_statement: The analytic proof is self-contained apart from standard normal-cone equilibrium criteria. The numerical verifier exercises finitely many noncritical test cases and is not an infinite proof or an independent audit. Historical-priority risks are detailed in the scientific review.
scientific_limitations: Exact signatures are for uniform-density right regular bipyramids with polygon order at least three and positive parameters away from the two explicitly classified degenerate transition values; no claim concerns oblique apices or global extremal equilibrium minima.
title: Two sharp equilibrium transitions in homogeneous regular bipyramids
